label: Home modules
description: Home module switch (spec §15.5 / §55–§57): which home modules render, and in which order. RECORDED ONLY as of 2026-09-29 — no page consumes it yet, and this description says so on purpose (see REQ-037): measured on this build (live daemon 4939, Chrome/153) that a bound record cannot gate page blocks — `visible` on `$state.*` fails open for an empty value, and only synchronous `$session.*` is a dependable conditional, so a settings-record-driven block switch is not expressible today. The value grammar is a comma-ordered token list over the two modules that exist today: hero = the hero-carousel frame, latest = the latest-published list. Values are constrained by `options` (fail closed: the settings CLI rejects anything outside them).
